verdict.rationale: Forter documents an official MCP server that lets an AI system take real actions, such as reviewing decisions, managing disputes and updating policies, through natural language. It also has a getting-started guide for connecting it to Claude Desktop, and a probe confirmed the docs page at docs.forter.com/mcp. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detailed documentation of the tool list and authentication, and evidence of setup for MCP clients beyond Claude Desktop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
